40015388.author: पदार्थः
40015388.content: महाबाहुः mighty armed, परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of enemy cities, रामः Rama, शङ्खविमित्रेण blowing of conches, राघवः Raghava, भेरीशब्देन by the noise of drums, उपयाति marched forth.

40015388.author: Translation
40015388.content: The mighty armed Rama, the conqueror of enemy cities, Raghava marched forth with the noise of the blowing of conches and the sounds of drums.

40015389.author: पदार्थः
40015389.content: अथ and then, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, तम् that, निनादम् sound, निशम्य hearing, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, ध्यानम् reflecting, आस्थाय considering, सचिवान् ministers, अभ्युदैक्षत looked at.

40015389.author: Translation
40015389.content: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas, looked at his ministers on hearing the sounds and reflecting for a moment.

40015390.author: पदार्थः
40015390.content: अथ and then, महाबलः very strong, जगत्सन्तापनः scourge of the world, क्रूरः cruel, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, तत्र, सर्वान् to all, सचिवान् companions, आभाष्य addressed, सर्वाम् every one, सभाम् entire assembly, संवादयन् speaking, गर्हयन् abused, इति this, उवाच said.

40015390.author: Translation
40015390.content: Thereafter the mighty Lord of Rakshasas, a cruel one, a scourge of the world addressed the assembly of his ministers and spoke abusing them.

40015391.author: पदार्थः
40015391.content: भवन्तः time being, रामस्य Rama's, यत् that Hanuman, अस्यसागरस्य that ocean, तरणम् crossing, विक्रमम् valour, बलसञ्जियम् prowess, उक्तवन्तः have told, तत् all that, मया by me, श्रुतम् heard.

40015391.author: Translation
40015391.content: "You have told me about the valour of Hanuman the messenger of Rama and his prowess in crossing the ocean which I heard just now."

40015392.author: पदार्थः
40015392.content: द्युद्धे in war, सत्यपराक्रमान् of truthful valour, रामविक्रमम् Rama's prowess, विदित्वा knowing, तूषिकान् stand mute, अन्योन्यम् each other, ईक्षतः looking at, भवतश्चापि I know you too, अहम् I, वेमदि know.

40015392.author: Translation
40015392.content: "Even though you are truly valorous in war, on knowing Rama's prowess, you are standing mute looking at each other. I know that."

40015393.author: पदार्थः
40015393.content: ततः then, सुमहाप्राज्ञः very wise, मातुः maternal, माल्यवान् Malyavan नाम by name, राक्षरः Rakshasa, रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः conversation, श्रुत्वा hearing, पैतामहः grandfather, अब्रवीत् said.

40015393.author: Translation
40015393.content: Then, Malyavan the maternal grandfather of Ravana, a very wise Rakshasa indeed said this on hearing Ravana's statement.

40015394.author: पदार्थः
40015394.content: राजन् O King, यः whoever, राजा king, विद्यासु all the fourteen sciences, अभिविनीतः path of justice, समामगः, सः he, चिरम् for long, ऐश्वर्यम् sovereignty, शास्ति ruler, अरींश्च enemies, वशे win over, कुरुते enjoys

40015394.author: Translation
40015394.content: "O king! Whoever is well versed in all the fourteen sciences and is a follower of justice, he alone wins over enemies and rules the kingdom for long."

40015395.author: पदार्थः
40015395.content: कालेन at that time, अरिभिः enemies, सन्दधानः encountering, विगृह्णान् expanding, स्वपक्ष one's own side, वर्थनम् acting, कुर्वन् doing, महत् great, ऐश्वर्यम् sovereignty, अश्नुते enjoys.

40015395.author: Translation
40015395.content: "Continuing to act in that way in course of time a king who encounters his enemies and expands his own side, enjoys great sovereignty."

40015396.author: पदार्थः
40015396.content: हीयमानेन when losing strength, समेवच with equal, राज्ञा with king, सन्धिः join, कर्तव्यः duty, शत्रुम् with enemy, नअवमन्येत not disrespecting, ज्यायान् quitting, विग्रहम् hostility, कुर्वीत do.

40015396.author: Translation
40015396.content: "When a king is losing strength, he should join hand s with the enemy who is equal to him. He should not disrespect the enemy but quit his hostility and join him (if the enemy is more powerful)."

40015397.author: पदार्थः
40015397.content: रावण Ravana, तत् that, रामेणसह with Rama, सन्धिः join, मह्यम् for us, रोचते agreeable, यदर्थम् for which, अभियुक्ता: favourable, स्मसीता Sita, तस्मै to him, प्रतीयताम् restore to him.

40015397.author: Translation
40015397.content: "O Ravana! Joining with that Rama is agreeable to me. Let that Sita for whose sake you have been attacked be restored to him."

40015398.author: पदार्थः
40015398.content: सर्वे all, देवर्षय: celestial sages गन्धर्वाश्च Gandharvas, यस्य their, जयैषिणः wishing victory, तेन therefore, विरोधम् enmity, मागमः do not, ते to you, तेन therefore, सन्धिः alliance, रोचताम् desirable.

40015398.author: Translation
40015398.content: All the celestial sages and Gandharvas are wishing him victory. Therefore, do not have enmity. Making an alliance with him is desirable for you.

40015399.author: पदार्थः
40015399.content: भगवान् God, पितामहः grandfather Brahma, सुराणांच deities and, असुराणांच devils also, द्वौ both, पक्षौएव orders, असृजत् created beings, धर्माधर्मौ virtue and vice, तदाश्रयौ taking refuge.

40015399.author: Translation
40015399.content: "The divine Brahma, the grandfather of the universe created two orders, deities and devils. They took the refuge of virtues and vices respectively."

40015400.author: पदार्थः
40015400.content: राक्षस Rakshasa, धर्मः righteous, महात्मानाम् great souls, असुराणाम् and Rakshasas, पक्षी side, श्रूयते, अधर्मः unrighteous, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, असुराणांच and devils, पक्षःहि being the side.

40015400.author: Translation
40015400.content: "The great souls were towards righteousness and Rakshasas took the side of unrighteousness."

40015401.author: पदार्थः
40015401.content: धर्मः moral merit, यदा similarly, अधर्मम् unrighteous, ग्रसते destroyed, कृतंयुगम् Krtam Yuga, अभूत् not exist, अधर्मः unrighteousness, धर्मम् righteousness, ग्रसते eclipses, तदा so also, तिष्यः end, प्रवर्तते commences.

40015401.author: Translation
40015401.content: "When moral merit destroys unrighteousness, it is called Krtayuga. So also, when virtue gets eclipsed by unrighteousness, it is called Kaliyuga."

40015402.author: पदार्थः
40015402.content: सत् being good, लोकान् the worlds, चरता ranging, त्वया by you, महान् great, धर्मोऽपि even righteous conduct, विनिहतः giving up, अधर्मः unrighteous, प्रगृहीतश्च embraced by you, तेन therefore, परे enemy, अस्मत् more than you, बलिनः stronger.

40015402.author: Translation
40015402.content: "While you were ranging in all the worlds, you gave up righteousness and embraced unrighteousness. Therefore, the enemy who is righteous is stronger than you."

40015403.author: पदार्थः
40015403.content: ते you, प्रमदात् mistakenly, वदिवृद्धः nourishing, सः he, अधर्मः unrighteous, वः those, ग्रसतेहि will swallow, सुरभावनः cause of celestials (to become powerful), सुराणाम् for the divine celestials, पक्षम् side, विवर्थयतिच grow in strength also.

40015403.author: Translation
40015403.content: "You are nourishing unrighteousness mistakenly. Therefore, it is going to swallow us. It has become the cause for the divine celestial side to become powerful."

40015404.author: पदार्थः
40015404.content: विषयेषु in matters, प्रसक्तेन excessively engaged in, यत्किञ्चित्कारणा indeed for that reason, त्वया by you, अग्निकल्पनामा burning fire, ऋषीणाम् to the seers, महान् great, उद्वेगः agitation, जनितः created.

40015404.author: Translation
40015404.content: "Being engaged in matters of sense pleasures you have created great agitation(disturbance) in the minds of the seers (engaged in penance) who resemble gods of burning fire."

40015405.author: पदार्थः
40015405.content: तेषाम् their, प्रभावः power, प्रदीप्तः blazing, पावकःइव like fire, दुर्धर्षः difficult to overcome, तपसा austerity, भावितात्मानः greatpure souls, धर्मस्य virtues, अनुग्रहे following, रताः remaining, तेनित्यं all of them, द्विजातयः Brahmanas, मुख्यैः important, तैस्सैः standing firmly, यज्ञैः sacred fire, यत् curbing the senses, यजन्ति sacrificing, अनगींश्च into fire, जुह्वति offering oblations, विधिवत् traditionally, वेदान् Vedas, उच्चैः reciting, अधीयते chanting constantly, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, अभिभूय subdue, ब्रह्मघोषान् mistakes, उदैरयन् intending, सर्वे all, उष्णगे hot season, स्तनयित्नुःइव like rain clouds, दिशः directions, अपि besides, विद्रुताः running.

40015405.author: Translation
40015405.content: "Their power is difficult to overcome as they are pure souls and blazing like fire by their austerity. They follow virtues faithfully intending to acquire merit like brahmanas. They are standing firmly curbing their senses doing sacrifices offering oblations into sacrificial fires following tradition. Having subdued the Rakshasas, they are continuing to recite Vedas and on hearing Vedas the Rakshasas are running away in different directions like the rain cloud is scattered in the hot season."

40015406.author: पदार्थः
40015406.content: तेषाम् their, प्रभावः power, प्रदीप्तः blazing, पावकःइव like fire, दुर्धर्षः difficult to overcome, तपसा austerity, भावितात्मानः greatpure souls, धर्मस्य virtues, अनुग्रहे following, रताः remaining, तेनित्यं all of them, द्विजातयः Brahmanas, मुख्यैः important, तैस्सैः standing firmly, यज्ञैः sacred fire, यत् curbing the senses, यजन्ति sacrificing, अनगींश्च into fire, जुह्वति offering oblations, विधिवत् traditionally, वेदान् Vedas, उच्चैः reciting, अधीयते chanting constantly, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, अभिभूय subdue, ब्रह्मघोषान् mistakes, उदैरयन् intending, सर्वे all, उष्णगे hot season, स्तनयित्नुःइव like rain clouds, दिशः directions, अपि besides, विद्रुताः running.

40015406.author: Translation
40015406.content: "Their power is difficult to overcome as they are pure souls and blazing like fire by their austerity. They follow virtues faithfully intending to acquire merit like brahmanas. They are standing firmly curbing their senses doing sacrifices offering oblations into sacrificial fires following tradition. Having subdued the Rakshasas, they are continuing to recite Vedas and on hearing Vedas the Rakshasas are running away in different directions like the rain cloud is scattered in the hot season."

40015407.author: पदार्थः
40015407.content: तेषाम् their, प्रभावः power, प्रदीप्तः blazing, पावकःइव like fire, दुर्धर्षः difficult to overcome, तपसा austerity, भावितात्मानः greatpure souls, धर्मस्य virtues, अनुग्रहे following, रताः remaining, तेनित्यं all of them, द्विजातयः Brahmanas, मुख्यैः important, तैस्सैः standing firmly, यज्ञैः sacred fire, यत् curbing the senses, यजन्ति sacrificing, अनगींश्च into fire, जुह्वति offering oblations, विधिवत् traditionally, वेदान् Vedas, उच्चैः reciting, अधीयते chanting constantly, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, अभिभूय subdue, ब्रह्मघोषान् mistakes, उदैरयन् intending, सर्वे all, उष्णगे hot season, स्तनयित्नुःइव like rain clouds, दिशः directions, अपि besides, विद्रुताः running.

40015407.author: Translation
40015407.content: "Their power is difficult to overcome as they are pure souls and blazing like fire by their austerity. They follow virtues faithfully intending to acquire merit like brahmanas. They are standing firmly curbing their senses doing sacrifices offering oblations into sacrificial fires following tradition. Having subdued the Rakshasas, they are continuing to recite Vedas and on hearing Vedas the Rakshasas are running away in different directions like the rain cloud is scattered in the hot season."

40015408.author: पदार्थः
40015408.content: अग्निकल्पानाम् poured into fire, ऋषीणाम् by the seers, अग्निहोत्रासमुत्थितः into the sacrificial fires, धूमः smoke, दश all ten, दिशः directions, व्याप्य spread, रक्षसाम् of the Rakshasas, तेजः brilliance, आदत्ते take away.

40015408.author: Translation
40015408.content: "By the spread of smoke in different directions from the sacrificial fires from the oblations offered by the seers the brilliance of the Rakshasas is taken away."

40015409.author: पदार्थः
40015409.content: पुण्येष्वेव at holy places दृढव्रतैः determined firmly, तेषुतेषु those, देशेषु regions चर्यमाणम् performing, तीव्रम् intense, तपः austerities, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, सन्तापयति tormenting.

40015409.author: Translation
40015409.content: "The intense austerities performed by the sages in different regions determined firmly are tormenting the Rakshasas."

40015410.author: पदार्थः
40015410.content: त्वया by you, देवदानवयक्षेभ्यः Devas, Danavas and Yakshas, वरः boons, गृहीतः obtained, बलवन्तः strong, दृढविक्रमाः powerful valour, महाबलाः mighty, मनुष्याः human beings, वानराः Vanaras, ऋक्षाः Bears, गोलाङ्गूलाः monkeys with dark face, इह now, आगम्य come here, गर्जन्ती thundering.

40015410.author: Translation
40015410.content: "You have secured boons of immunity against death at the hand s of strong and mighty and powerful valour, like gods, Danavas, Yakshas and human beings. The Vanaras, Bears and monkeys with dark faces are coming here now thundering."

40015411.author: पदार्थः
40015411.content: त्वया by you, देवदानवयक्षेभ्यः Devas, Danavas and Yakshas, वरः boons, गृहीतः obtained, बलवन्तः strong, दृढविक्रमाः powerful valour, महाबलाः mighty, मनुष्याः human beings, वानराः Vanaras, ऋक्षाः Bears, गोलाङ्गूलाः monkeys with dark face, इह now, आगम्य come here, गर्जन्ती thundering.

40015411.author: Translation
40015411.content: "You have secured boons of immunity against death at the hand s of strong and mighty and powerful valour, like gods, Danavas, Yakshas and human beings. The Vanaras, Bears and monkeys with dark faces are coming here now thundering."

40015412.author: पदार्थः
40015412.content: विविधान् different, उत्पातान् rising up, तथा like that, बहुविधान् in various ways, घोरान् dreadful, दृष्टवा seeing, अहम् I, सर्वेषाम् all, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, विनाशम् destruction, अनुपश्यामि foresee.

40015412.author: Translation
40015412.content: "Beholding different dreadful ones rising up in various directions, I foresee destruction of all Rakshasas."

40015413.author: पदार्थः
40015413.content: खराभिस्न्तिताः emitting hot thunder, घोराः formidable, प्रतिभयङ्कराः very frightening, मेघाः clouds, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः all over, उष्णेन by the heat, शोणितेन by blood, अभिवर्षन्ति raining.

40015413.author: Translation
40015413.content: "Formidable clouds are emitting hot and most frightening thunder drenched by rain of blood all over Lanka."

40015414.author: पदार्थः
40015414.content: रुदताम् weeping, वाहनानाम् carrying, अस्रबिन्दवः tear drops, प्रपतन्ति falling, ध्वजाध्वस्ताः horses and elephants, विवर्णाः discoloured by dust, यधापुरम् as before, नप्रभान्ति not shining.

40015414.author: Translation
40015414.content: "With tear drops falling from the eyes of weeping horses and elephants (carrying army) they are discoloured by dust and are not shining like before."

40015415.author: पदार्थः
40015415.content: व्यालाः wicked, गोमायवः jackals, सुभैरवम् most frightful, वाश्यन्ति vultures, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविश्य entering, मनिशम् deep, समवायन् gather, कुर्वते crying.

40015415.author: Translation
40015415.content: "Wicked jackals and vultures are entering deep into Lanka and gathering. They are crying most frightfully."

40015416.author: पदार्थः
40015416.content: काळिकाः coal black, स्त्रियः women, स्वप्नेषु in dreams, प्रतिभाष्य speaking, गृहाणि omen, मुष्ण्नत्यः plundering, अग्रतः before, स्थिताः standing, पाण्डुरैः yellow, दन्स्सैः teeth, प्रहसन्ति laughing heartily.

40015416.author: Translation
40015416.content: "Women of dark colour like coal with yellow teeth are speaking unpleasant things standing before us in dreams laughing heartily."

40015417.author: पदार्थः
40015417.content: गृहाणाम् in the homes, बलिकर्माणि offerings of food made for gods, श्वानः dogs, पर्युभुञ्जते are coming to eat, गोषु cows, खराः donkeys, प्रजायन्ते procreating, नकुलैहिः mongoose, मूषकाः rats सह also.

40015417.author: Translation
40015417.content: "In the houses, food offerings made for gods are eaten by dogs, donkeys are procreating cows and rats of mongoose."

40015418.author: पदार्थः
40015418.content: मार्जराः cats, द्वीपिभिः leopards सार्थम् having company, सूकराः pigs, शुनकैःसह dogs also, किन्नराः Kinnera, राक्षसैश्चापि Rakshasas as well, मानुषैःसह including human beings, समेयुः mating.

40015418.author: Translation
40015418.content: "Cats are having the company of (mating) Leopards, pigs are mating with dogs, Kinneras with Rakshasas as well as human beings also."

40015419.author: पदार्थः
40015419.content: पाण्डुराः white, रक्तपादाश्च redfooted, कपोताः doves, विहगाः birds, कालचोदिताः impelled by time, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, विनाशाय boding destruction, विचरन्ति move about.

40015419.author: Translation
40015419.content: "The white and redfooted doves are moving about impelled by time spirit boding destruction of Rakshasas."

40015420.author: पदार्थः
40015420.content: वेश्मसु in the households, स्थिताः living, शारिकाः minas, कलहैषिणः grapple, निर्जिताः dead, वीचीकूचीति delight, वाश्यन्तः inhabiting, ग्रथिताश्चापि bellicose birds, पतन्ति falling down.

40015420.author: Translation
40015420.content: "Minas living in households grappling with bellicose birds in delight are falling down dead."

40015421.author: पदार्थः
40015421.content: पक्षिणः birds, सर्वे all, मृगाः animals, प्रत्यादित्यम् hostile, रुदन्ति crying, कराळः dreadful, विकटः monstrous, मुण्डः shaven head, परुषः male, कृष्णपिङ्गळः blackish, कालः time, कालेकाले at all times, सर्वेषाम् all, गृहाणि households, अन्ववेक्षते considering, एतानि all this, अन्यानि complete, दुष्टानि sinister निमित्तानि portents, उत्पतन्ति making appearance.

40015421.author: Translation
40015421.content: All birds and animals are making hostile noise. Time is always coming in a dreadful and monstrous blackish form with a shaved head, morning, and evening. Considering all these sinister portents are making an appearance at all households.

40015422.author: पदार्थः
40015422.content: पक्षिणः birds, सर्वे all, मृगाः animals, प्रत्यादित्यम् hostile, रुदन्ति crying, कराळः dreadful, विकटः monstrous, मुण्डः shaven head, परुषः male, कृष्णपिङ्गळः blackish, कालः time, कालेकाले at all times, सर्वेषाम् all, गृहाणि households, अन्ववेक्षते considering, एतानि all this, अन्यानि complete, दुष्टानि sinister निमित्तानि portents, उत्पतन्ति making appearance.

40015422.author: Translation
40015422.content: All birds and animals are making hostile noise. Time is always coming in a dreadful and monstrous blackish form with a shaved head, morning, and evening. Considering all these sinister portents are making an appearance at all households.

40015423.author: पदार्थः
40015423.content: रामम् Rama, मानुषम् human being, रूपम् form, आस्तितम् assuming, विष्णुम् Vishnu, मन्यामहे Lord, दृढविक्रमः fortitude and prowess, असौ oh, राघवः Raghava, मानुषमात्रः only a human being, नहि not, येन therefore, समुद्रे on the ocean, परमाद्भुतः most amazing, सः he, सेतुः bridge, बद्धः constructing, रावण Ravana, नरराजेन ruler of men, रामेण with Rama, सन्धिम् align, कुरुष्व make, कर्माणि action, ज्ञात्वा know, अवधार्य determine correctly, आयतिक्षमम् after careful thinking, क्रियताम् be done.

40015423.author: Translation
40015423.content: Rama is Lord Vishnu in human form endowed with fortitude and prowess. One who has constructed an amazing bridge on the ocean is not just a human being. O Ravana! Align with the ruler of men, Sri Rama. After careful thinking and determining correctly, do what is good.
